title: Waiting on God
definition: Waiting on God is trusting His timing, promises, wisdom, and faithfulness when answers, relief, or fulfillment are delayed.
summary: Waiting is not passive hopelessness. It is active trust, prayer, obedience, and endurance while depending on God's character.
christFocus: Christ teaches His people to trust the Father even when the path includes delay, suffering, or uncertainty.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Waiting is not passive hopelessness. It is active trust, prayer, obedience, and endurance while depending on God's character.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
